decisions.reason: The weir dimensioning web tool costs little to maintain and supports lead generation with engineering planners for the firm's weir products D and F, so keeping the option open remains worthwhile.
The spring-controlled flap weir was launched only in 2024 close to the core flood-control offer, its market value is still uncertain and holding it is cheap, so the option should stay open.

The energy management system fits the firm's strategic move toward digital networking and energy efficiency, and its prospects with utilities have not yet resolved, which justifies keeping it as a growth option.
The overflow flap gate line has its own web page and several models, which signals commitment and early traction in the core business, so abandoning it now would be premature.
